terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (1 - belief) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == -9) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == -9) * (1 - belief)
explanation: Active only at GO (zero at D1/D2). The magnitude is carried by a specific two-trial history: the last trial was a2 and rewarded, and the trial before was a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded. That cell gets about +0.4 to +1 depending on the ideal-observer belief that S2 is good (weight ~1.1 on 1 - belief), and slightly less when the last a2 went to S2 (common). After a2-rewarded trials with any other trial-before pattern it stays near zero (each of the other 7 patterns is about -0.03 to -0.04), and after a1 trials or unrewarded trials it is about zero. When the trial before falls outside the window it gets a small 1 - belief term. Most of the remaining misses are large GO activations on the first window trial, where the history is not visible. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.38 (dev 0.40), above the profile all observed 0.30 and all 0.35 additive references. The earlier model-based label (high value, strong a2 policy) is replaced by observed history plus belief; nothing is lost in fit.
